title: You Only Need 2/3 of the Chosen Experts: An Empirical Study of Dynamic Expert Pruning in Fine-Grained MoE LLMs
selection_reason: Uniformly pruning one third of selected MoE experts preserves 98.8% performance and yields measured 1.2-1.7x speedups on two LLM serving backends.
